name: subject_missing_visits
sql: SELECT s.id AS subject_id, s.enrolled_on FROM subjects s LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.subject_id = s.id WHERE v.id IS NULL

name: visit_before_enrollment
sql: SELECT v.id AS visit_id, v.subject_id, v.visited_on, s.enrolled_on FROM visits v JOIN subjects s ON s.id = v.subject_id WHERE s.enrolled_on IS NOT NULL AND v.visited_on < s.enrolled_on

name: visit_without_enrollment
sql: SELECT v.id AS visit_id, v.subject_id, v.visited_on FROM visits v JOIN subjects s ON s.id = v.subject_id WHERE s.enrolled_on IS NULL

name: duplicate_visit_same_day
sql: SELECT subject_id, visited_on, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visits GROUP BY subject_id, visited_on HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

name: orphan_visit_subject_missing
sql: SELECT v.id AS visit_id, v.subject_id, v.visited_on FROM visits v LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = v.subject_id WHERE s.id IS NULL

name: slow_query_timeout_demo
sql: WITH RECURSIVE cnt(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM cnt WHERE x < 1000000000) SELECT x FROM cnt
